sloka: वेणु स्वर व्यंजित तूर्य मिश्रःप्रत्यूष काले अनिल संप्रवृत्तः ।संमूर्च्छितो गह्वर गो वृषाणाम्अन्योन्यम् आपूरयति इव शब्दः ॥४-३०-४९॥
transliteration: veṇu svara vyaṁjita tūrya miśraḥpratyūṣa kāle anila saṁpravṛttaḥ ।saṁmūrcchito gahvara go vṛṣāṇāmanyonyam āpūrayati iva śabdaḥ ॥4-30-49॥

translations.english: 'Lakshmi, the goddess of wealth (also of autumn) appears decorated with deep wells like an excellent lady with swans as girdles and blooming lotuses and lilies as garlands.
